title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Pavilion, UCLA on 1978-12-30
lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi DR-1)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM-270 mics (left side, first row of seats above bleachers next to railing, even with the soundboard) > Sony TC-158SD (TDK SA-C90)

ai_review.summary: Great‑sounding recording but mislabeled date, making the source uncertain
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the audio quality, calling it a great‑sounding upload, yet points out that the concert is incorrectly dated – it’s actually the 12‑28‑78 San Diego show rather than the advertised 12‑30 UCLA performance. No musical details are given, so the assessment focuses on sound fidelity and metadata error.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review; it rates the audio highly but flags a major labeling mistake, leaving overall confidence low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the upload as 'great sounding' despite no specific details about soundboard or audience source.
